segments.label: ORIGINAL JAPANESE ROM | CONDITIONAL TEST | paused
segments.headline: A smaller gap works, but does not install the top
segments.detail:
The game creates a 632-unit position disagreement.
Crawl and the initial Mario/box positions are supplied.
This is a local mechanism demonstration, not a clean gameplay route.
segments.footer: Normal gameplay image. Exact coordinates come from the recorded trace.

segments.label: NORMAL CAMERA | SUPPLIED CRAWL | slow motion
segments.headline: Prepare an established crawl before the position cut
segments.detail:
The earlier no-A four-pillar controller replay is omitted.
Crawl action is supplied; a native update makes its hitbox 100 high.
Next, all three Mario positions and the box position are supplied.
segments.footer: No floor cache, velocity, timer, held reference or display gap is written.

segments.label: RENDER-ONLY STARTING-COORDINATE ILLUSTRATION | paused
segments.headline: Y = 1400 is a supplied hover, 120 above the roof
segments.detail:
Mario: (-2132, 1400, -1024). Box: (-2093, 1400, -1024).
Roof Y = 1280. The 100-high body would end at Y = 1500.
The loaded cap underside is 1518, then 1523 on the next update.
segments.footer: Camera, render positions and render matrices changed for this illustration only.

segments.label: RENDER-ONLY COORDINATE ILLUSTRATION | two recorded frames
segments.headline: The box pushes Mario 68 units west
segments.detail:
The actual next input is Z plus stick (0, 64), with no A.
The native push takes X from -2132 to -2200.
The stopped crawl then retains the earlier display height.
segments.footer: Render edits are restored before input; the logged gameplay matches the stock run.

segments.label: RENDER-ONLY DISPLAY-COORDINATE VIEW | paused
segments.headline: Movement/collision Y = 768; stored display Y = 1400
segments.detail:
Both now use X/Z = (-2200, -1024). The difference is 632.
A stopped ground quarter preserves the low floor cache.
Display refresh precedes crawl alignment and the collision copy.
segments.footer: Mario is drawn at the stored display coordinates by clearing his render matrix.

segments.label: BACK TO NORMAL CAMERA AND NATIVE RENDER MATRIX | paused
segments.headline: Stored display coordinates are not the final model transform
segments.detail:
Crawl also supplies a separate floor-alignment render matrix.
The ordinary game image therefore differs from the illustration.
The 632-unit disagreement is verified in memory, not measured in pixels.
segments.footer: The stock run has no render edits. The illustration is a separate matching replay.

segments.label: NORMAL CAMERA | NEXT UPDATE | paused
segments.headline: The raised retry reaches the roof, not the top
segments.detail:
The low floor query misses; the retry uses the raised display.
It selects the static roof at Y = 1280.
Mario accepts the upper warp, but remembers no spinning-top platform.
segments.footer: The starting hover and box placement remain supplied assumptions.

segments.label: NORMAL CAMERA | CONTINUOUS WARP CONTINUATION | slow motion
segments.headline: The continuation gives an ordinary Area-2 arrival
segments.detail:
All later controller inputs are neutral; A-input counters stay zero.
First Area-2 position: (0, 5500, 256).
Mario lands inside the elevator rather than bypassing it.
segments.footer: The two warp-transition inputs without camera callbacks are recorded in the trace.

segments.label: NORMAL CAMERA | ORDINARY ELEVATOR OUTCOME | paused
segments.headline: A gap alone is not enough
segments.detail:
This supplied below-cap setup makes a smaller gap successfully.
Its retry does not capture the top, so the useful displacement is absent.
segments.footer: Observed finite example; not an exclusion of other positions, phases or mechanisms.

segments.label: RENDER-ONLY STARTING-COORDINATE ILLUSTRATION | OPEN PREDECESSOR
segments.headline: What still has to be produced through gameplay
segments.detail:
There is no standing floor at this supplied Y = 1400.
Reach an established high crawl with an available pushing actor,
then create enough retained display height at useful warp timing.
segments.footer: This test supplies the hover and action. A complete clean no-A route remains open.
